PURPOSE: Agent ecosystem lineage graph: identity + permission grants + connectivity + activity as a deterministic, evidence-bound, replayable projection over the PING event spine. Answers 'who did what with which permission', computes effective-permission reachability, and detects cross-boundary paths no approval authorized ('toxic combinations'). Epistemic (read-only) authority only; enforcement stays in capability-kernel and proposal-kernel.
SMALLEST_MISSING_PRIMITIVE: Grant-anchored actor lineage edge with temporal reachability: one derived edge type (actor_identity, grant_id, action, target, t_observed, evidence_ref) over the event spine, plus effective-reach query (transitive closure at time T) and drift detection (effective reach minus explicitly approved reach). Zero dependencies; one projection-kernel module.
